About Factory

Our mission is to bring autonomy to software engineering.

We build software development agents that accelerate the world's largest enterprise engineering teams. We're helping customers including Nvidia, Adobe, Adyen, Klarna, and Ernst & Young turn their engineering organizations into autonomous development systems — shipping code, reviewing PRs, running tests, and deploying continuously.

About the Role

Factory is looking for highly capable engineers to own and lead engineering projects across our product suite. You will work closely with our design, research, engineering, and GTM teams to build a platform that delivers tremendous value to our customers.

What you will do and achieve

  • Design, develop, and maintain critical platform features from the ground up, ensuring they meet our high standards for scalability, performance, and user experience.
